## Generate Simulated Data

#### Coefficients
```{r}
# create first set of fourier coefficients
generate_fourier_coef <- function(nb, sd0 = 2, p=2.5) {
  K <- (nb - 1) / 2
  k <- rep(1:K, each = 2) #coefficient index vector
  sd_k <- sd0 / (k^p) 
  rnorm(2 * K, mean = 0, sd = sd_k)
}

#### SPHERE TO ELLIPSE TRANSFORM METHOD ####
# slightly different decay structures each time

generate_coef_pair <- function(nb, sd0 = 2, d = 1, p = 2.5, seed = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  coef1 <- generate_fourier_coef(nb, sd0, p)
  
  # uniform sphere direction
  z <- rnorm(length(coef1))
  u <- z / sqrt(sum(z^2))  # unit length
  
  # ellipsoid axes (impose more relaxed decay structure)
  axes <- 1 / (1:length(coef1))^(p*runif(1, 0.7, 1.4))
  
  # scale to ellipse
  dir <- u * axes
  
  # renormalize
  dir <- dir / sqrt(sum(dir^2))
  
  # shift by d
  coef2 <- coef1 + d * dir
  
  list(coef1 = coef1, coef2 = coef2)
}
```

#### Noise
```{r}
sim_fn_noise <- function(n = 500, ar.cor = 0.9, sigma = 0.3, nb = 25, sd0 = 2, d = 2, p=2.5, plotit = TRUE) {
  # simulate random periodic drift
  fb <- create.fourier.basis(rangeval = c(0, n), nbasis = nb, period = n)
  
  # generate two coefficient sets at distance d
  coefs <- generate_coef_pair(nb = nb, sd0 = sd0, d = d, p=p)
  
  
  # construct trends
  x1 <- (eval.basis(1:n, basisobj = fb)[, -1] %*% coefs$coef1) |> scale()
  x2 <- (eval.basis(1:n, basisobj = fb)[, -1] %*% coefs$coef2) |> scale()
  
  # Adding noise
  ar.cor <- 0.5 
  sigma <- 0.7

  # ARMA model coefficients

  # Short Memory Coefs MA1
  phi1 <- 0
  phi2 <- 0
  theta1 <- 0.25
  theta2 <- 0

  # # Slow decay Coefs with ARMA 21
  # phi1 <- 0.8
  # phi2 <- 0.1
  # theta1 <- 0.3
  # theta2 <- 0

  ar.coefs <- c(phi1, phi2)        # AR coefs
  ma.coefs <- c(theta1, theta2)    # MA coefs

  noise1 <- arima.sim(
    model = list(order = c(2, 0, 2), ar = ar.coefs, ma = ma.coefs),
    n = n,
    rand.gen = function(t){ rnorm(t, mean = 0, sd = sigma) },
    n.start = 100
  )

  noise2 <- arima.sim(
    model = list(order = c(2, 0, 2), ar = ar.coefs, ma = ma.coefs),
    n = n,
    rand.gen = function(t){ rnorm(t, mean = 0, sd = sigma) },
    n.start = 100
  )

  # add noise to drift
  y1 <- x1 + noise1
  y2 <- x2 + noise2
  
  # Unsure of lambda placement?
  
  if (plotit) {
    ylim <- c(-1.1, 1.1) * max(abs(c(x1, y1, y2)))
    plot(x1, type = "l", ylim = ylim)
    lines(y1, col = "red")
    lines(y2, col = "blue")
    
  }
  
  out <- list(y1 = y1, y2 = y2)
}


# Test
x <- sim_fn(n = 500, nb = 25, sd0 = 2, d = 1, p=2.5)

y1 <- x[["y1"]]
y2 <- x[["y2"]]
```
#### Simple Noise
```{r}
sim_fn <- function(n = 500, ar.cor = 0.9, sigma = 0.3, nb = 25, sd0 = 2, d = 2, p=2.5, plotit = TRUE) {
  # simulate random periodic drift
  fb <- create.fourier.basis(rangeval = c(0, n), nbasis = nb, period = n)
  
  # generate two coefficient sets at distance d
  coefs <- generate_coef_pair(nb = nb, sd0 = sd0, d = d, p=p)
  
  
  # construct trends
  x1 <- (eval.basis(1:n, basisobj = fb)[, -1] %*% coefs$coef1) |> scale()
  x2 <- (eval.basis(1:n, basisobj = fb)[, -1] %*% coefs$coef2) |> scale()
  
  
   # simulate noise series
  noise1 <- arima.sim(model = list(order = c(1, 0, 0), ar = ar.cor),
                      n = n,
                      rand.gen = function(t){rnorm(t, mean = 0, sd = sigma)},
                      n.start = 100)
  noise2 <- arima.sim(model = list(order = c(1, 0, 0), ar = ar.cor),
                      n = n,
                      rand.gen = function(t){rnorm(t, mean = 0, sd = sigma)},
                      n.start = 100)
  
  # add noise to drift
  y1 <- x1 + noise1
  y2 <- x2 + noise2
  
  # Unsure of lambda placement?
  
  if (plotit) {
    ylim <- c(-1.1, 1.1) * max(abs(c(x1, y1, y2)))
    plot(x1, type = "l", ylim = ylim)
    lines(y1, col = "red")
    lines(y2, col = "blue")
    
  }
  
  out <- list(y1 = y1, y2 = y2)
}


# Test
x <- sim_fn(n = 500, nb = 25, sd0 = 2, d = 1, p=2.5)

y1 <- x[["y1"]]
y2 <- x[["y2"]]
```

## Fit Null Model

```{r}
nullmodel <- fit_null_model(y1,
               y2,
               q = NULL,
               h = NULL,
               alpha = 0.05,
               rho0 = 0,
               max_pq = 2)


# Test
entry_rate <- nullmodel[["expected_asymptotic"]][["entry_rate"]]
mean_run_length <- nullmodel[["expected_asymptotic"]][["mean_run_length"]]
```

## Parametric Bootstrap

```{r}
boot <- bootstrap_local_corr(nullmodel) 

# Test
entry_rate <- boot[["expected_asymptotic"]][["entry_rate"]]
mean_run_length <- boot[["expected_asymptotic"]][["mean_run_length"]]

p.entry <- boot[["p_values"]][["entry_rate"]]
p.length <- boot[["p_values"]][["mean_run_length"]]

```

## d simulation

```{r}
# N: number of simulation 
d_sim <- function(N = 5, d = 1){
  
  sim <- matrix(NA, nrow = N, ncol = 6)
  colnames(sim) <- c("d",
                     "sim_n",
                         "entry_rate",
                         "p.entry",
                         "mean_run_length",
                         "p.length")
  
  for (i in 1:N){
  
  x <- sim_fn(n = 500, 
              ar.cor = 0.9, 
              sigma = 0.3, 
              nb = 25, 
              sd0 = 2, 
              d = d, 
              p=2.5, 
              plotit = FALSE)
  
  nullmodel <- fit_null_model(x$y1,
               x$y2,
               q = NULL,
               h = NULL,
               alpha = 0.05,
               rho0 = 0,
               max_pq = 2)
  
  boot <- bootstrap_local_corr(nullmodel) 
  
  entry_rate <- boot[["expected_asymptotic"]][["entry_rate"]]
  mean_run_length <- boot[["expected_asymptotic"]][["mean_run_length"]]

  p.entry <- boot[["p_values"]][["entry_rate"]]
  p.length <- boot[["p_values"]][["mean_run_length"]]
  
  sim[i,] <- c(d, 
               i,
               entry_rate, 
               p.entry, 
               mean_run_length, 
               p.length)
  }
  return(as.data.frame(sim))
}


d_vals <- c(7.6,  8,  8.4,  8.8,  9.2,  9.6,  10,  10.4,  10.8,  11.2, 11.6, 12)
d_data <- map_dfr(d_vals, ~ d_sim(N = 75, d = .x))

write_csv(d_data, "order1.csv")
```

```{r}
# N: number of simulation 
d_sim <- function(N = 5, d = 1){
  
  sim <- matrix(NA, nrow = N, ncol = 6)
  colnames(sim) <- c("d",
                     "sim_n",
                         "entry_rate",
                         "p.entry",
                         "mean_run_length",
                         "p.length")
  
  for (i in 1:N){
  
  x <- sim_fn_noise(n = 500, 
              ar.cor = 0.9, 
              sigma = 0.3, 
              nb = 25, 
              sd0 = 2, 
              d = d, 
              p=2.5, 
              plotit = FALSE)
  
  nullmodel <- fit_null_model(x$y1,
               x$y2,
               q = NULL,
               h = NULL,
               alpha = 0.05,
               rho0 = 0,
               max_pq = 2)
  
  boot <- bootstrap_local_corr(nullmodel) 
  
  entry_rate <- boot[["expected_asymptotic"]][["entry_rate"]]
  mean_run_length <- boot[["expected_asymptotic"]][["mean_run_length"]]

  p.entry <- boot[["p_values"]][["entry_rate"]]
  p.length <- boot[["p_values"]][["mean_run_length"]]
  
  sim[i,] <- c(d, 
               i,
               entry_rate, 
               p.entry, 
               mean_run_length, 
               p.length)
  }
  return(as.data.frame(sim))
}


d_vals <- c(7.6,  8,  8.4,  8.8,  9.2,  9.6,  10,  10.4,  10.8,  11.2, 11.6, 12)
d_data <- map_dfr(d_vals, ~ d_sim(N = 50, d = .x))

# write_csv(d_data, "n.csv")
```



```{r}
new <- d_data |>
  mutate(reject_entry = case_when(
    p.entry >= 0.05 ~ "no",
    p.entry < 0.05 ~ "yes"
  ),
  reject_length = case_when(
    p.length >= 0.05 ~ "no",
    p.length < 0.05 ~ "yes")
  ) |>
  group_by(d) |>
  summarise(
    n_sim = n(),                           
    n_reject1 = sum(reject_entry == "yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_reject2 = sum(reject_length == "yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_reject_entry = n_reject1 / n_sim,
    prop_reject_length = n_reject2 / n_sim        
  ) |>
  ungroup()




p1 <- new |>
ggplot(aes(x = d, y = prop_reject_entry)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()
p1

p2 <- new |>
ggplot(aes(x = d, y = prop_reject_length)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()
p2

```
